blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_evidence: The four tables and PII/ePHI validators, unique columns, conditional ZCQL behavior, Advanced I/O raw bytes/host, packaged Function Job target, immediate Job, disabled-first one-minute Cron, and pinned SDK response shapes have not been provisioned and independently read back in Catalyst Development.

Catalyst Mail sender verification, the approved synthetic Development recipient, live response mapping, exactly-once delivery/replay evidence, and restoration to dry_run have not been exercised. Source defaults to DryRunRecorded and contains a bounded send_development path; no delivery is claimed.

The number-bound shared agent's actual provider behavior has not been read back for resolver timeout, 503, malformed JSON, invalid override, or endpoint unavailability. Its exact first-node no-data gate is verified, but provider fallback behavior still requires a controlled Development route test.
No Development phone call has proven resolver-to-call-to-notification-record lifecycle and practical 25-call behavior.

closed_external_evidence.evidence: The reviewed shared Development agent passed the exact configuration gate, direct no-data fallback, deliberate closing, and all 25 native simulation cases without hard-coded client ownership.

known_mvp_tradeoffs: There is no pre-call reservation. Concurrent calls already in flight when the 25th handled call converges may create a visible practical overshoot.
Every first valid terminal ended post-call event counts once; error/not-connected lifecycle rows remain uncounted and notification remains pending until call_analyzed arrives.
Reporting is a minimized per-client Data Store query or sanitized CSV export; Analytics and CRM writes are absent.

Number reassignment is not a runtime feature or an initial-validation requirement. Do not reuse either test number during initial validation; after a test ends, preserve ownership metadata and place the number into a documented cooldown before any separately reviewed future reuse.
